---

### Install

1. Download **OpenShelf-VERSION.dmg** below, open it and drag **OpenShelf** onto **Applications**.
2. Open OpenShelf from Applications. It lives in the menu bar (the wheel icon).
3. OpenShelf isn't notarized by Apple yet, so macOS asks once on first launch:
   - **macOS 15 and later:** click Done, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**.
   - **macOS 14:** right-click the app → **Open** → **Open**.
   - Or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/OpenShelf.app`

Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later, on Apple silicon or Intel. See the [README](https://github.com/Manan-Santoki/OpenShelf#how-to-use) for how to use it.
